issue.title: Grok Build double-loads CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md as duplicate project instructions
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-l3.6 (epic sase-l3, Grok Build LLM provider) and confirmed again by sase-l3.land during epic landing.

ROOT CAUSE: Grok Build reads AGENTS.md natively, so SASE intentionally generates no GROK.md shim (tests/main/test_init_memory_agent_docs.py::test_provider_instruction_shims_do_not_include_grok pins this). But Grok Build 1.0.3 ALSO recognizes SASE's generated CLAUDE.md as project instructions and loads both files, feeding the model the same instruction content twice. Phase sase-l3.6 verified this with a live 'grok inspect' run under a temporary HOME: both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md are reported as project instructions. Setting '[compat.claude] agents = false' in Grok's config does NOT suppress the generic CLAUDE.md load.

IMPACT: Every SASE agent run on the grok provider pays double the instruction-token cost for AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md content and risks the model treating duplicated directives as emphasis. The duplication is currently accepted and documented rather than fixed -- see the 'Instruction double-load' section of docs/agent_providers.md.

SCOPE: Find a narrower mitigation than suppressing CLAUDE.md generation under a Grok provider. Simply not generating CLAUDE.md would break any human running 'claude' in the same tree, which is why sase-l3 declined it. Options worth evaluating: a Grok-side config knob that disables generic-CLAUDE.md discovery (recheck against Grok Build releases newer than 1.0.3), making the Claude shim a symlink/pointer to AGENTS.md so a double load costs nothing, or emitting a short CLAUDE.md that defers to AGENTS.md. Update the docs/agent_providers.md 'Instruction double-load' section with whatever posture is chosen.

REPRODUCE: deploy SASE instruction files into a scratch tree, point HOME at a temp dir with an authenticated Grok Build 1.0.3, and run 'grok inspect'; both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md appear as project instructions.
